# FFNDS research agent instructions

Root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) is binding; load local AutoResearcher v2.3 `mechanism-research`, `research-expansion`, `ffnds-paper-discovery` skills. The evidence and open-idea navigator is [exploration index](../research/exploration/20261022/EXPLORATION_INDEX.md), and the outcomes-oriented synthesis is [docs/67](../docs/67_后训练动态FFN开放探索与质量速度目标_20261022.md).

Read `CURRENT_DECISION` and [completed R12 E0](../docs/66_R12等预算动作的操作数与条件粒度审计.md) for actual state. V3/V4 and earlier R12 pair plans are exploratory **options, not mandated implementations**. Produce constructive new algorithms and actively execute cheap source, saved-data or CPU checks; select a few decisive controlled native tests and account for video quality/real inference cost. Preserve scoped negative results and immutable test gates. Do not self-register or run GPU model work.

**User's updated evaluation priority:** read [docs/72](../docs/72_与同前提方法竞争的质量速度评价准则_20261022.md). Old 50%/1.5×/2% targets are **reference/historical registration values, not global hard gates for future proposals**. Aim for reproducible Pareto improvement versus best matched prior art/UB1 under comparable video, model, hardware and training settings; keep new candidates free to explore novel action/budget regimes. Do not alter the frozen gates or results of historical R12 D0/R4/R11, or self-authorize GPU experiments.

**Candidate promotion gate:** once a method is selected as a serious backup, it MUST generate at least one genuine full free-running paired candidate I2V video, without resetting to dense between denoising steps; visually screen motion, foreground, small background objects and stable lighting for collapse. Do not mark viable/video-safe based on native-local SSE, synthetic GPU kernel speed or reset-to-DQ TF2 videos. One pass is a smoke only. Read [docs/75](../docs/75_备选算法必须完整生成与防止视频质量崩溃_20261022.md) and maintain research/candidate_rollout/registry/ records; use tools/check_candidate_rollout_gate.py. GPU work still requires explicit separate user authorization.

**Evaluation ontology binding (2026-10-22):** [docs/76](../docs/76_基于学术文献的FFNDS分层指标体系_20261022.md) / [metric catalog](../research/metric_system/catalog.json) define L0–L5 grain-separated metrics. Do not relabel L1 local SSE as video loss, reset flow as free generation, random-tensor kernel speed as end-to-end speed or VBench three historical axes as full I2V quality. Claims must use the matching tier, source exposure, native/full-video execution mode, measured evidence and strongest comparable baseline. Execute python tools/check_metric_contract.py; preserve exact completed R14N0/R11 historical records. No model/GPU authorization implied.
